title: Cartwise Grocery Orders Service Levels: Windows, Minimums and Handoff
content:
Cartwise Grocery Orders are sold at six service levels, ranked from Curbside Pickup (rank 1) to Stock-Up Delivery (rank 6). Each order is booked at exactly one service level, and the figures below are fixed by that service level.

## Service-level catalogue

| Service level | How the order reaches the customer | Promised window length | Booking ahead | Order minimum (item subtotal) | Most item units on one order | Items may be added or removed | Unattended drop-off |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | pickup | 60 minutes | up to 7 calendar days | 10.00 USD | 150 | until shopping starts | not allowed |
| No-Rush Delivery | delivery | 300 minutes | up to 7 calendar days | 10.00 USD | 150 | until shopping starts | allowed |
| Standard Delivery | delivery | 120 minutes | up to 7 calendar days | 10.00 USD | 150 | until shopping starts | allowed |
| Priority Delivery | delivery | 60 minutes | same day only (0 days ahead) | 10.00 USD | 150 | until shopping starts | allowed |
| Express 30 Delivery | delivery | 30 minutes | same day only (0 days ahead) | 10.00 USD | 25 | until shopping starts | allowed |
| Stock-Up Delivery | delivery | 180 minutes | up to 7 calendar days | 125.00 USD | 300 | until shopping starts | not allowed |

## Notes to the catalogue

- **Fulfillment mode.** Curbside Pickup is the only service level whose order is collected by the customer at the store; the other five deliver to the customer's address.
- **Window length** is the length, in minutes, of the delivery or pickup window promised at checkout.
- **Booking ahead** is how many calendar days ahead a window may be booked; a figure of 0 means a window can be booked for the same day only.
- **Order minimum** is the lowest item subtotal at which the order can be placed; **most item units** is the ceiling on item units billed on one order.
- **Entry to the service level.** Priority Delivery is offered for same-day windows only. Express 30 Delivery is offered only when the order holds no more than 25 item units and the delivery address lies within 3.0 miles of the store. Stock-Up Delivery starts at an item subtotal of 125.00 USD; every other service level starts at 10.00 USD.
- **Unattended drop-off** marks whether an order at that service level may be left without anyone taking it in hand.

## Reading the catalogue (hypothetical baskets)

- A hypothetical same-day basket of 30 item units cannot be booked at Express 30 Delivery, because 30 is above that service level's 25-unit ceiling; at Standard Delivery the ceiling is 150 units.
- A hypothetical basket with an item subtotal of 124.99 USD sits below the Stock-Up Delivery minimum of 125.00 USD; at 125.00 USD exactly, the minimum is met.
